one_liner: Cloud observability platform for monitoring, logging, and APM, with a REST API for metrics, logs, and dashboards.

auth.evidence_quote: Authenticate to the API with an [API key](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/api-app-keys.md#api-keys) using the header `DD-API-KEY`.
auth.notes: Most endpoints need both an API key and an Application key ('DD-APPLICATION-KEY'); Datadog's MCP server documentation mentions OAuth for some client integrations (e.g. Grok), but the core REST API itself is documented as key-based, not OAuth2, so oauth2 omitted pending further verification.

access.evidence_quote: Authenticate to the API with an API key using the header DD-API-KEY.
access.notes: Datadog offers a 14-day free trial rather than a permanent free API-accessible tier for most products; not independently re-confirmed with a pricing-page quote this pass.

api.evidence_quote: Set Up the Datadog MCP Server
api.notes: Datadog's API reference spans dozens of product areas (metrics, logs, monitors, dashboards, incidents, etc.), consistent with 'broad'; not counted precisely this pass. Official remote MCP server confirmed at mcp.datadoghq.com with regional endpoints.

verdict.rationale: API/App key auth obtainable via a trial account, a broad REST API, and an official MCP server support building now, though the permanent-free-tier claim needs re-verification.
